items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Leon's wife who's nickname was Boop

ctx.x: We passed through Switzerland which was a beautiful country and arrived in Venice the 22nd of October and that was where the trip started to get interesting. I had read some of the history of Venice and its canals and it says that there is no other city like Venice. We went from the railroad station to the pier by taxi gondolas and watched the way the gondolier guided the gondola and the traffic on the canals. It was a real sight to see. From the pier there was a launch that took us to the ship we were to sail…

The weather was beautiful in Venice and we left the port in the afternoon. The following day we rented deck chairs and I began to get better acquainted with the musicians whom I had not known much about before. This was Leon's second time to be engaged at the Taj. Charlie Lewis was known as "Dizzy" and "Dizzy" called Leon "Dog". We started calling Cosey "Bags" because he had a ruptured testicle which really showed, but it didn't seem to bother him physically. He in turn called everybody "funny looking", even…

We arrived at night in Port Said, Egypt and went ashore for a few hours as it was early evening and the ship would not sail until that night through the Suez Canal. The Canal is 87-and-a-half miles long and took at least 12 to 15 hours to traverse. Egypt was the starting point going to the Far East and there were so many sights that we saw for the first time to indicate to those that had never seen the likes of it to let him know that this part of the world was the land of the Pharaohs. To our way of thinking,…
